title: Marguerite and the Veil
author: I. M. Reyes
blurb: Jude Pemberton, an exiled storm-caller, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
